title: Atik Mustafa Pasha Mosque
axis: Positive X points toward the apses and positive Z toward the south wall.

nativeAxes.x: from the timber entrance toward the apses

source: Named current footprint aligned with the historical survey and current heritage inventory.
identityStatus: The named current outline measures 18.80 m by 15.54 m. The architectural inventory records a 17.5 m by 15 m original church body, three polygonal apses and a tower at the southwest corner.

terrainContact.basis: Original terrain immediately west of the raised timber entrance.

notes: Van Millingen describes triple arcade bays, an upper tripartite light and three externally faceted apses. Eyice and Istanbul’s religious-affairs inventory record the timber porch and later single-balcony stone minaret with a stone cap. Qualla’s exact 2025 interior photograph shows the uninterrupted dome bowl and taller side windows of the restored building.
